name: Yoshimi Kaho
source:
An employee of the office where the main character works.
She has a serious and clear personality. She is a firm and independent woman.

She is the wife of Takahiro Yoshimi and has been married for about four years.
She and her husband were married through an arranged marriage recommended by their business associates, and they married each other to save face with the matchmaker,
However, their personalities do not get along, and although they act normally on the outside, their marriage is not on the best of terms (not acrimonious).
After a failed first night with her husband, she has been sexless and has had almost no sexual experience.
